theorems.statement: ∀ (P k m' n' : ℕ) (g : Fin k → Euclid P) (h : n' = k + m') (E : Set (Euclid P)) (A : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) m') (RA : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) m'), 0 < m' → Orthonormal ℝ g → MeasurableSet E → E ⊆ (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range g) : Set (Euclid P)) → RA.Represents A → RA.measure ((Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range g))ᗮ : Set (Euclid P))ᶜ = 0 → ∃ (B : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n') (RB : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n'), RB.Represents B ∧ (∀ C : Set (Euclid P), MeasurableSet C → RB.measure C = ∫⁻ t in E, RA.measure ((fun y => t + y) ⁻¹' C) ∂μHE[k]) ∧ ∀ flat : Covector (Euclid P) n' → Covector (Euclid P) m', (∀ (α : Covector (Euclid P) n') (v : Fin m' → Euclid P), flat α v = α (Fin.append g v ∘ Fin.cast h)) → ∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n', B ω = ∫ t in E, currentEval A (fun y => flat ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n') (t + y))) ∂μHE[k]
